data.name: Halloween Stories: The Death Card Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
This season, Elephant Games proudly presents an eerie new entry in the spine-tingling Halloween Stories series!

When Christine, her husband Mark, and the rest of their friends are back in their hometown to bring back their favorite childhood Halloween tradition – a night at “the witch’s house,” a legendary house that locals say was once owned by a real-life witch! But this Halloween is going to be anything but traditional after Christine discovers that Death is an uninvited guest for their friendly get-together! Can you help Christine decipher her premonition, determine who is after her, and live through the night? There’s only one way to find out! Sink into this bone-chilling Halloween Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game full of Halloween spirit!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Explore the mysteries of the afterlife in the bonus chapter!

  • Outwit Death itself with the Strategy Guide!

  • Enjoy a downloadable atmospheric soundtrack!

  • Stay in the spooky spirit with a creepy collection of desktop wallpapers!

  • Find tarot cards and morphing objects, and collect pumpkins to unlock the secret room!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game - a sub genre of point & click adventure. Follow protagonists on a story-driven quest, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve various puzzles to advance the plot.
